```artifact
Feature: Alarms and Temperature Sensing

  Scenario: Battery failure alarm has high priority
    Given the system is operational
    When a battery failure is detected
    Then the battery failure alarm is triggered with priority level 1

  Scenario Outline: GUI reads temperature sensors for blower motor, blower power management system, and battery cell
    Given the system is operational
    When the temperature of the <component> is read
    Then the GUI displays the temperature of the <component>
    Examples:
      | component                |
      | blower motor             |
      | blower power mgmt system |
      | battery cell             |

  Scenario Outline: Blower motor temperature too high alarm triggered by user-specified threshold
    Given the system is operational
    And the user sets the blower motor temperature threshold to <threshold>
    When the blower motor temperature reaches <temperature>
    Then the "blower motor temperature too high" alarm is triggered
    Examples:
      | threshold | temperature |
      | 100       | 100         |  # Normal value
      | 100       | 101         |  # Edge value
      | 100       | 99          |  # Below threshold
      | 100       | -10         |  # Invalid value

  Scenario Outline: Blower power system temperature too high alarm triggered by user-specified threshold
    Given the system is operational
    And the user sets the blower power system temperature threshold to <threshold>
    When the blower power system temperature reaches <temperature>
    Then the "blower power system temperature too high" alarm is triggered
    Examples:
      | threshold | temperature |
      | 120       | 120         |  # Normal value
      | 120       | 121         |  # Edge value
      | 120       | 119         |  # Below threshold
      | 120       | -20         |  # Invalid value

  Scenario Outline: Battery temperature too high alarm triggered by user-specified threshold
    Given the system is operational
    And the user sets the battery temperature threshold to <threshold>
    When the battery temperature reaches <temperature>
    Then the "battery temperature too high" alarm is triggered
    Examples:
      | threshold | temperature |
      | 150       | 150         |  # Normal value
      | 150       | 151         |  # Edge value
      | 150       | 149         |  # Below threshold
      | 150       | -10         |  # Invalid value

  Scenario Outline: Safety action invoked when blower power system temperature is above threshold
    Given the system is operational
    And the user sets the blower power system temperature threshold to <threshold>
    When the blower power system temperature reaches <temperature>
    Then the safety action is invoked within 1 second
    Examples:
      | threshold | temperature |
      | 120       | 121         |  # Above threshold
      | 120       | 120         |  # At threshold

  Scenario Outline: Safety action invoked when battery temperature is above threshold
    Given the system is operational
    And the user sets the battery temperature threshold to <threshold>
    When the battery temperature reaches <temperature>
    Then the safety action is invoked within 1 second
    Examples:
      | threshold | temperature |
      | 150       | 151         |  # Above threshold
      | 150       | 150         |  # At threshold

  Scenario Outline: System rejects invalid blower motor temperature threshold
    Given the system is operational
    When the user sets the blower motor temperature threshold to <threshold>
    Then the system rejects the threshold and does not trigger an alarm
    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | -10       |  # Invalid value

  Scenario Outline: System rejects invalid blower power system temperature threshold
    Given the system is operational
    When the user sets the blower power system temperature threshold to <threshold>
    Then the system rejects the threshold and does not trigger an alarm
    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | -20       |  # Invalid value

  Scenario Outline: System rejects invalid battery temperature threshold
    Given the system is operational
    When the user sets the battery temperature threshold to <threshold>
    Then the system rejects the threshold and does not trigger an alarm
    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | -10       |  # Invalid value
```
